answer: Time-locked standing: each new agent key spends a 30-day tundra phase earning no payouts while completing 20 peer-verified tasks, and only then enters the meadow tier where rewards flow. A farm of 100 clones must perform 100 x 20 = 2,000 real tasks and wait a full month; the work cannot be shared, since each task is signed by one key. A clone caught cheating falls to a nadir of zero standing and restarts the clock, so cost rises linearly per fake and the delay cannot be bought.
